title: Update channel
why: This machine checks for signed updates about every six hours and only ever installs an image whose signature it has verified. Stable moves only after an upgrade-and-rollback proof has passed; beta gets every build first. Updates are staged and wait for a restart unless you turn on automatic restarts in the next step. Change it any time with `awnix update channel stable|beta` or the console's Updates tab.

options.label: Stable (recommended)
options.detail: Proven builds only: each one passed the upgrade and rollback drill before it reached this channel.

options.label: Beta
options.detail: Every build as soon as it is published and signed, before it is proven. For test machines.
